stay.price_basis: Kanheri Caves sit inside Sanjay Gandhi National Park at Borivali, within Mumbai; they are visited as a day trip (open 9 am to 5 pm per search summaries). No lodging inside the park. Stay in Mumbai (see the mumbai entry for hotel medians).
stay.notes: Entry fees are NOT reliably known: traveltriangle.com (title 'updated 2025') says SGNP entry Rs 85 per Indian adult, Kanheri an extra Rs 10, private vehicles Rs 61 motorcycle / Rs 242 car / Rs 428 bus. Search summaries of other 2026 sites say Kanheri is Rs 40 for Indians (Rs 600 foreigners) or Rs 25, plus a shuttle bus of about Rs 60, and that private cars may no longer be allowed. These conflict, so treat as approximately Rs 85 park entry plus Rs 10-40 for the caves, and check at the gate.

taxi_day.basis: No separate Kanheri cab rate found. It is reached by local cab, auto or train to Borivali and then a park shuttle or walk, and sources disagree on whether private cars may enter. See the mumbai entry for a full-day cab.
taxi_day.notes: traveltriangle.com lists vehicle entry Rs 242 for a car, but newer search summaries say private vehicles are not permitted in the main park area.

food_per_person_day.basis: No rupee menu or thali price found for the park. Day trip from Mumbai, so Mumbai food prices apply.

unverified: Park shuttle fare and vehicle rules

taxi_day.basis: Cars cannot go beyond Dasturi Naka, so there is no taxi day: visitors take the Neral-Dasturi shared taxi (30-40 min, 100 per seat, or 500 for the whole taxi), then walk, an e-rickshaw (35 per seat) or a horse (300 for a short ride, 300-600 Dasturi to the market, 800-1,200 for a full 4-5 point ride, all negotiable). Entry fee at Dasturi 50 per adult and 25 per child. Toy train Neral to Matheran second class 75 adult / 45 child, but the Neral-Aman Lodge service is reported suspended 15 June to 15 October 2026 for the monsoon (magickworld.in, verified 24 Aug 2026), with the Aman Lodge-Matheran shuttle still running at 45 second class.
taxi_day.notes: Hand-pulled rickshaws were listed at 700-800 by goadventure.in (June 2025), but a search summary of a 2026 guide says the Supreme Court ordered them banned in August 2025 in favour of e-rickshaws, which I did not confirm on a fetched page. The matherantourism.com page is undated (footer 2023). A Gozocabs page for Neral-Matheran showed 1,782 for 66 km, which is a wrong place match, so it was not used.
